wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.bonding.desc: Two Bonding Earrings. Two Z Fighters who each wear one, facing each other, become one fighter at once for 30 minutes: any lineage, no dance.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_tim: You are one. The fusion holds for %s min.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_bur: Your form burns the fusion: %1$s s left, running %2$s%% faster.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_charm_cann: Only a Z Fighter who is free to fuse can use this.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_charm_face: Face the fighter you would bond with, within five blocks.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_charm_offe: You hold yours out to %s. They must answer in kind.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_charm_aske: %1$s holds out a %2$s to you. Face them and use yours to agree.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_earrings_c: The earrings crack and fall away.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_bands_crac: The arm bands split and fall away.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_tyrant_ear: The fallen tyrant's ear glitters: a pair of Bonding Earrings.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_five_agree: The ring of five: %1$s of %2$s have answered.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_five_ring: Stand round one another in a ring, no wide gaps, and answer again.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_master_fus: %1$s: "Not yet. Learn more from me first." (%2$s of %3$s lessons)
